result.stdout:
Description:
  QR code generator tool — encode text as console, SVG, PNG, JPEG, ASCII, or PDF

Usage:
  qrgen <text> [options]

Arguments:
  <text>  The text to encode in the QR code

Options:
  --format <format>                      Output format (console|svg|png|jpeg|ascii|pdf) [default: console]
  --output <output>                      Write to file (required for png/jpeg/pdf)
  --module-size <module-size>            Pixels/units per module [default: 10]
  --fg <fg>                              Foreground color as hex [default: #000000]
  --bg <bg>                              Background color as hex [default: #ffffff]
  --error-correction <error-correction>  Error correction level (low|medium|quartile|high) [default: medium]
  --invert                               Invert colors (console mode only) [default: False]
  --quality <quality>                    JPEG quality 0-100 [default: 85]
  --ascii-style <ascii-style>            ASCII art style (block|hash|dot|shade) [default: block]
  --title <title>                        Title for PDF output
  --version                              Show version information
  -?, -h, --help                         Show help and usage information
